title: JEPA observation-grounded transition evidence
description: Evidence contract for training a one-step JEPA action predictor against a later observed embedding. The Rust API recomputes embedding digests; raw observation, history and action-manifest digests must be authenticated by the upstream adapter.

source_observation_sha256.description: Upstream digest of the observed source frame/event bytes; not recomputed from the HDC embedding.

source_embedding_sha256.description: Recomputed by the JEPA crate over the canonical HDC f32 bit representation.

target_observation_sha256.description: Upstream digest of the later acquired target observation bytes; not a model-generated target.

target_embedding_sha256.description: Recomputed by the JEPA crate over the canonical target HDC f32 bit representation.

x-rust-invariants: the action index must exist in the configured discrete action space
source_embedding_sha256 and target_embedding_sha256 are recomputed from the exact supplied ContinuousHV values and must match
both embeddings must have the configured input dimension and finite f32 values
